composition_subtypes.role: sort teleporters by min travel cost from endpoints
select cheapest teleporters greedily after sorting, with binary search on prefix sums

payload.core_composition_summary: Sorts teleporters by min endpoint distance, then iterates over each as first used, greedily picks cheapest remaining via prefix sum binary search.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts based on a custom key (min distance to 0 or n+1) to enable greedy selection of the cheapest subsequent teleporters, with binary search to maximize count per first choice.
